newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - HBO & Co raised to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - HBO & Co raised to buy.

text.p: -- Lehman Brothers analysts Greg Wilson and Chris Russ on Tuesday raised their rating for HBO & Co to buy from outperform.
-- The upgrade was "based, in part, on renewed momentum of top-line revenues through strong internal growth," they wrote in an analysis.
-- "... At 26.5x our 1998 estimate, we believe that the stock is trading at its most attractive risk/reward valuation in the past four years."
-- Shares in the Atlanta software company were up 1-7/8 to 58-7/8.
